Salut, eu sunt Patrick și sunt ghid turistic. Îmi place să te plimb pe tărâmuri pe care n-ai bănuit că le poți explora. E ceva irezistibil în forța viscerală a naturii, în energia primară a pădurilor dese, care ascund mistere fascinante. Nopțile sub cerul liber sunt specialitatea mea. Știu să te ridic până la stele.

Acum, însă, sunt pe un traseu periculos. Mia e o clientă importantă. E sora celui mai bun prieten al meu. E o femeie complicată, care a lăsat în urmă multe inimi zdrobite. Totodată, e fata pe care o iubesc în secret de când am văzut-o prima oară.

Cum va decurge această călătorie cu cod roșu de furtună emoțională și prognoză de descărcări electrice răvășitoare?

It's finally Patrick and Mia's turn to find love in Hard Wood. Hard Wood is a stand alone however both character's previously appeared Joy Ride.

I never fail to fall in love with Lauren Blakely's stories. Hard Wood is a swoony romance that will warm your heart and possibly other body parts. I fell quick and hard for Patrick Milligan, a normal, comfortable guy with a fantastic butt and an in-the-know feline companion.

Patrick's ready to settle down but the woman he wants happens to live clear across the county. He never finds the right time to tell Mia how he feels. He is in a continual battle with his emotions, keeping his feeling under wraps.

Mia Summers confides her feels for Patrick to his cat, Zeus. She's falling in love with Patrick but she's not sure if he feels the same. Her subtle hints are not enough.

Their struggle is heartfelt. They don't want the sting of rejection so they stop before baring their souls. I love that this story is written in Patrick's POV. I love reading his thoughts and feeling his emotions. Plus we get Zeus, the first-to-know feline who doesn't share secrets. It gives the story a special zest. Lauren Blakely has nailed down giving us the male POV. I hope she continues. 5 Stars!

A rom-com that's heavy on the romance with plenty of humor and a guaranteed happy ending is pretty much my idea of a perfect book. That's why I impatiently await each new rom-com Lauren Blakely releases. She doesn't disappoint! Especially when it’s time for the last of the Big Rock heroes to get his Happily Ever After. With Hard Wood (heehee), we have a best friend’s sister romance told via all-male-POV. This book has everything you could want in a romance: a heartwarmingly sweet love story, love scenes so sexy they'll make your jaw drop and your cheeks flush, and characters that’ll claim your heart from page one. In short, Hard Wood is another top favorite read by Lauren Blakely.

I love how everyone is connected in the Big Rock universe. Whether they’re close friends or relatives, they all run in the same circle that gets increasingly wider with each new book. Whenever new characters are introduced, I can’t help but wonder if they’ll soon appear in their own book. Luckily, that’s usually the case, such as with Patrick (Max’s close friend and Evie’s brother) and Mia (Chase and Max’s sister). The moment these two first met in a previous book, sparks flew, and my brain immediately started plotting the potential romance between them. Their story is, of course, everything I could’ve imagined and then some, complete with electric chemistry, palpable sexual tension, and flirtatious banter. There’s no unnecessary drama or drawn-out angst, but rather an easygoing, fun-loving connection between two individuals that blossoms into something more.

It’s the romance between Patrick and Mia that had me swooning and grinning nonstop, but I have to admit that what I love most about Hard Wood is Patrick, our incredibly charming narrator. As far as heroes go, he’s unpretentiously normal. He's not tortured, he's not a bad boy, and he’s not an over-the-top Alpha male. He runs a successful business, enjoys the outdoors, and wants to settle down (sigh). No, he's not flashy, but he is genuine and respectable, with an admirable sense of humor. Patrick is proof that a "good guy" is just as swoon-worthy, just as sexy, and just as romantic as any other fictional hero.

If you’re in the mood for a lighthearted rom-com with plenty of steam and minimal angst, Hard Wood is a must-read. It’s goofy and fun but also sensual and erotic, which is an irresistible combination that had me glued to my Kindle from start to finish. Although I’ll miss the Big Rock crew, Hard Wood is a perfectly satisfying, can’t-miss end to the series.

*complimentary copy provided by author for an honest review

5 Long-Awaited And Worth It Stars
YOU DON'T NEED HOME DEPOT
GET YOUR HARD WOOD FOR FREE!!!!!
* * * * * Spoiler Free
There's a feeling you get when you have been wanting something for a while...A type of anticipation, an excitement in the possibility of what is to come...This feeling can happen about big events you have planned and are counting the days for...But this fluttery feeling can also take place when pondering something simple....easy... and just plain pleasurable...

Like this book Hard Wood by Lauren Blakely. Ms. Blakey, the Master of Secondary Characters who are worthy of their own stories, has been taunting and teasing us with Patrick and Mia in a few books now. In one book, she would introduce them and a hint of an attraction... then in another, she would tip her hand and give Patrick and Mia a bit of brooding and longing...with all of this revealing more and more about who they were...

This way of giving us characters is genius and many authors do it... Ms. Blakely does not have a copyright on the practice...

But what Ms. Blakely does have is this subtle way of drawing the reader in...

It is Not Too Much or Over the Top force-feeding us to be interested...
It is also Not Too Little so that we have to rack our brain to remember who the hell these people are...
It is the Just Right Amount to lock us down and set us up to be curious...
This is the way she links all of these characters together as Real Life Family and Friends...

There is no forced purpose. You can believe people became friends because they happened to live in the same apartment building. Links from college are always strong and holding onto relationships happens every single day. Brothers have Sisters... Sisters have Brothers and marriages widens social circles...All of these life events happen and Blakely just causes them to flow into one another.... but never forced.

And with all of this background, we have been wondering about Patrick and Mia...

Well, the wait is over, and O.M.F.G..... All the anticipation and flutters you felt, were minor compared to what you will feel while reading this book. I mean it. If in Real Life, any of you experience the type of Man Patrick is...then Kiss the Ground and Say a Prayer that you have been given such a gift.

This Patrick is so special in his straight forward understanding of who he is and what he wants out of life. We are given the insight into how this man developed from the awkward gangling boy into this self-assured man. He has no pretense... just the desire for a simple direct life. It is having a company that promotes what he loves, the outdoors. He has taken his love of the outdoors and of animals and made it a successful business. He is smart, well-read and just charming...

And then we have Mia...a product of a loving family with a brother who was her champion. He looked out for her in all the standard brotherly ways... but did even more... He showed her how to take something she thought was a weakness and make it a strength... He gave her the ability to handle any challenge and not back down.

Mia is equal to Patrick in her ability to take what she loved and make it a successful business. She loved animals and she loved beauty... She decided to make beauty products that are Cruelty-Free... and it has served her well. Her business in San Francisco has taken off and it is growing by leaps and bounds.

These two had all the makings for a wonderful coming together...except there was this one little thing holding Patrick back from seriously pursuing Mia...

Actually, it was more than one....it was more like 3,000...
Yeah... Patrick lived in New York City and Mia was living 3,000 miles away in San Francisco...
And we all know how well long-distance romances work...

But here is the deal...
Patrick is Smitten...
Patrick is Ready...
And he is More than Willing and Able...

He just needs to read the signs and figure out how to show Mia how ready he is for her...

This was as swoony as you could get... I wanted to eat these two up with a spoon, that's how perfect they were for each other. The dialogue was incredibly smart, the sex hotter than hot... and the love in their hearts... the best.

And just in case, all that I have told you isn't enough to pique your interest...
Then how about a cat named Zeus who is the holder of all truths...Every time Zeus was on the page... his sly way of understanding humans worked and made me grin.

Thank you, Lauren Blakely, for giving me everything I wanted... the anticipation, the flutters, and all the heart clutch a gal could want.

* 5 purrrrfect swoon-worthy stars *

Nobody makes me swoon like Lauren Blakely and with this book, I swooned HARD ! Hard Wood is Blakely's newest standalone story told from the male POV. It follows Patrick and Mia, two characters who have appeared previously, dancing around each other for awhile on the fringes of those stories. But now? Now it's finally their turn to find their happily ever after and Blakely wrote them one helluva love story that will sweep readers off their feet! There is SO MUCH to love in this book from the adorable characters and a hiking cat who has his own POV (!) to a fast paced love story and scorching hot sex scenes that might just set your Kindle ablaze!

Patrick and Mia are the epitome of the saying "made for one another". Both are entrepreneurs who turned their passions into successful companies. Living across the country from one another has prevented them from following their hearts and admitting their feelings for one another. When they finally take that leap and give in, the fun really starts! Seriously, even when they are getting down and dirty, these two are hilariously fun! Blakely found a way to bring out their individual senses of humor in the most creative ways. She had me laughing and smiling throughout. In fact, the entire story is one feel-good ride! I read Hard Wood right after finishing a book that had me feeling completely hung over and by the end of the second page of the prologue, I was smiling and feeling the Blakely magic take hold and transform my mood. The story is super fun and dedicated readers will revel in the events of past characters that take center stage in the background of this love story. Patrick's cat Zeus will endear readers, even those that are not really cat-lovers (raises hand and ducks in shame). A few strategically placed chapters told from Zeus's POV are Blakely comedic gold and give us a different perspective of what's happening in the story.

Patrick and Mia will take you on a whirlwind ride as their passion and love peaks in a fabulous happily ever after ending. You will laugh, you will swoon and you will feel completely enamored with everything about this book. With sexy characters, witty dialogue and a beautiful storyline, Hard Wood is the perfect feel good rom-com to put a smile on your face and set your heart aflutter.

Review and Excerpt at Of Pens and Pages.



Hard Wood is a fun and sweet, friends-to-lovers romance with a perfect, slow-burning build up to a happily ever after. We have two lovable characters and a feline companion that completely steals the show, and the best thing is it’s told in Lauren Blakely’s hilarious and realistic male POV.

Distance, past relationships, and current friendships hold back two people who have this strong and undeniable connection to cross that line past friendship. Patrick and Mia have this ease in their interactions while they were friends, and especially even after they were more, that shows exactly why friends to lovers romances are amazing.

I don’t care about the miles. I don’t care that we live on different coasts. All I care about is how I feel, not only when I’m near you, but when I think of you.”


What I love the most about this pair is how Ms. Blakely depicted a very realistic pair who are in a fresh/new relationship. They’re trying to find their way into a steady and solid relationship. Because of the new relationship, they won’t always know the right things to say or do, and I like that they had a conversation about not being able to read minds and that they’d have to communicate to make sure they’re in the same boat.

I love both Patrick and Mia! They’re equally focused on their careers and because of that, they both have successful businesses. They’re also very in-tune to each other’s interests and feelings, and very connected to each other. They’ve both close to their families, both looking to settle down, and both fun and adventurous. It’s a match made in heaven.

Shout out to Patrick for being so swoon-worthy! This man is romantic and serious about finding the one he’ll spend the rest of his life with, and when he’s 100% sure it’s Mia, he’s persistent in his pursuit. No going behind Mia’s brother or anyone, no pretenses. He’s upfront about it and I absolutely love it!

I’ve read about this pair in Ms. Blakely’s previous works and have always wondered when they were going to go from friends to lovers, and now that I have it, I’m very satisfied. If you think about it, it’s a really long build up for them. Their story didn’t start in Hard Wood. From sitting on the sidelines in Joy Ride to Stud Finder, then finally taking the reigns in Hard Wood, Patrick and Mia’s love story was the ultimate slow burn. And it’s great to see the other pairs in the Big Rock world living their life after their happily ever after, too.

If you’re looking for a light and fun romantic-comedy with great banter and sizzling chemistry, you’ll enjoy Hard Wood.

And Zeus? I want that cat for a pet. Pet of the year. Adorable.

Tropes: Friends to Lovers, Brother’s Best Friend
POV: First Person, Male POV
Standalone: Yes

Lauren Blakely's writing is my kryptonite. I'm not sure how she does it-how she makes me fall in love over and over again, but she does. She can take a trope I've read hundreds of times before-falling for a friend's little sister-and make it seem so fresh, fun and unique. This book had me swooning, laughing, sighing and grinning. I didn't want it to end but couldn't stop grinning when it did.

Mia was so much fun. I adore her sense of self, her strength. I admire her guts and willingness to go all in and make drastic changes in her life to seize a potential opportunity. She's willing to put herself out there and how can you not love that? She's down to earth and I love that. This is a character I'd go have a purple snow globe with any day of the week.

Patrick had serious swoon game. A man who knows what he wants, what he's ready for and who he wants it with?? Talk about a unicorn. A smart, hot, sexy and sweet unicorn. I admired Patrick. He wanted to do things the way he felt was right and I really liked that. He put his cards on the table (mostly!) and just went all in.

I have to admit I'm a sucker for the first kiss between the hero and heroine. An absolute sucker for them and I wasn't disappointed in this book. However, this book gave me a new thing to sigh over-the first hand hold. Oh, I was just a puddle. There's no denying the chemistry between these characters. It snaps and crackles in the banter they share and when they finally connect? Let's just say I there are definitely kindle melting moments here.

The writing here was so vivid that I felt like I could SEE everything these characters were experiencing. From the stars in the sky, to the twigs on a hiking trail and the felt on a pool table during a game, I could just see it. My heart skipped a beat more than once at moments between Patrick and Mia because I felt I was just there with them...in a totally non creepy way LOL. I was completely immersed in the story here.

This is the last book in the Big Rock series from this author but it can be read and enjoyed as a standalone. That being said, I personally loved getting to revisit characters from past books. It's one of the things this author does so incredibly well. The supporting characters never overwhelm the story, ever. I loved getting to see where those past characters are NOW. So thank you, Lauren Blakely, for giving those little glimpses into the other Big Rock characters here.

This book is full of sharp, sexy, sweet and fun banter. The pacing is perfect-and while I didn't want it to end, I couldn't keep the grin off my face when it did. Hard Wood was the perfect ending for this series, though it can absolutely be enjoyed as a standalone. I highly recommend this book.

So I have read basically all of Lauren Blakely's books. LOVE THEM and probably obsessed with almost ALL OF THEM! If I could I would put basically every single one on my top favorites list. This one definitely would be on the top of my favorite Lauren Blakely books. We have met both Mia and Patrick before. Mostly in Joy Ride. I knew they would have a book and I was without a doubt excited. Learning more about these two made this book even better than I expected as well.

Patrick is the perfect buff adventure guy. Owning his own company taking people on hikes, canoeing and other outdoor adventures. As Mia is the owner of a cruelty-free makeup coming. These two collide in the best way possible (yes sexual as well, hello this is a romance novel) even though they are both super busy and always traveling. The best part of this book is that they already have a big amount of chemistry and already did the get to know you stuff in the months that they have known each other. The downfall? They live in different states. About 3,000 miles away. Booooo!!! Plus there is the pesky fact that Mia is Patrick's best friend's sister. I mean these type of categories are my FAVORITE and thankfully Lauren Blakely got that memo because she has a lot of couples that are falling love with best friends siblings. Hallelujah!!!! <3

Thankfully Patrick and Mia are open minded on a lot of things and Patrick's clever cat, Zeus helps them basically get the sparks and chemistry moving faster. The romance is fast paced and moves easily. Not a lot of drama which is wonderful and these two actually communicate better than most couples do when they've been together for years. 

Although Lauren Blakely has published a bunch of books, she has once again made a story line unique and 100% individual in the romance reading world. Patrick and Mia are not your normal lead characters, which makes this book easy to fall in love with and easy to read. Without a doubt and no surprise I could not put this book down until I finished it. I was in a trance from the first chapter and the only cure was finishing this beauty of a book asap. 

As always bravo, Lauren Blakely. You will always be a go-to author for me. I don't even read the blurbs anymore because I know I will absolutely 100% without a doubt fall in love with your stories.

***ARC Provided by the Author***

I loved absolutely everything about this book. Wait, I am not happy that I finished it and it is over. I don't like that part. This is one of those books, the rare ones, where you wish you could forget everything about the book and read it again, for the first time. I don't want it to be over...I wanted another epilogue, and another, and another.

But, seriously, it was perfection.

Yeah, yeah, I know. I say that about all of Lauren Blakely's books. And, it is true about every single one of them, and for different reasons every time. This one, I could not stop smiling. And, I adored Zeus. The addition of Patrick's cat (as much as I am sure Zeus would protest this name) gave this book a humor, and a vibe that is so different than other books with pets, I think because Lauren Blakely clearly knows cats, and how they think...or at least how humans believe they think, as who knows. As a cat person myself, and one who absolutely loves the quirks of having a cat in my life (one of the "drag" variety who will not be going outside, unlike this cat), I adored Zeus.

It had characters you love, quotes by one of my favorite authors, cats you want to cuddle and get high on catnip, and recurring characters you are happy to see again. If you haven't read the other books, first, what are you thinking??? Go read them!!! And, second, the recurring characters don't keep this from being a standalone, and you can read it even if you haven't read the others (although I am still stuck on the idea that you might not have read them?!?!?) and still enjoy Patrick and Mia.

Patrick and Mia are perfect. I love that they know how perfect they are for one another from the beginning, and that it takes them a little time to tell one another. Not because they are afraid of rejection, or because they doubt their feelings, but because they are ok with waiting for the other person, for as long as it takes, for them to work out and be together. So perfect, charming and fun to read.

Zeus. I am not even sure what to say about Zeus. Wait, I don't need to say anything. He is a cat, and he already knows. Because, well, he is a cat. And, I ADORED him. I loved that he was a part of the book, and that he got to be a character. Because he is awesome...and all good romances should have a cat. Really.

Romance, for it to work, needs to engage the mind and the heart of the reader. You have to not only believe in the characters, you have to feel what they are feeling, their joy, their uncertainty, and their happiness. This is so easy to do with Lauren's books, as they are so well written they draw you in, and you feel all the feels, you can't help it...it just happens and you are willingly along for the ride.

The ending is perfect, and it is so true to them, to the way they have been the entire time. And, while this is hard to say without spoiling so I will be vague, the sheer romance of his idea, of how they should begin the new phase of their relationship is the kind of thing you will still be swooning over days later. It was probably the cat's idea.

I loved this book. And, I recommend it. Don't believe me? Just ask my cat Maxwell, he knows all...and knew it first.

Hard Wood is a standalone by the amazing Lauren Blakely! At this point I think she could write a rom-com in the male POV in her sleep and it will still make the Bestsellers list. One element I love in a Lauren book is the connections. I have been waiting for this story. The story of Mia (Max and Chase’s sister) and Patrick (Evie’s brother). They met a few months ago while Mia was traveling to NY on business and staying with his friend and neighbor Max. He wanted to get to know her then and falls deeper and deeper each time he sees her...

Patrick is at the point in his life where he wants to settle down. His adventure touring business is booming. His sister and his friends have found their match and now it’s his turn. Except he knows he has found is but she is off-limits. Not because she happens to be his buddy’s sister but because she lives three-thousand miles away in San Francisco. He knows that if he gets one taste of Mia while she is visiting NY than he won’t be able to let her go. She could not be a fling. She would be his everything. He would want her in his arms every night. Pitch a tent with her on the weekends. Walk his cat Zeus on a daily basis. He doesn’t know how she feels but it would be hard to watch her get on that plane if they tried. It would hurt if it ruined what they have now. A fun and flirty friendship. Well...that friendship kicks it up a notch with one night of passion. Now what?

Mia has wanted Patrick since the moment she laid eyes on him and more and more with each visit. She likes that he is a normal guy with an easygoing attitude with a good head on his shoulders. And it’s a bonus that his other head is just as amazing.She likes him. She also knows she could fall for him. That is why she hasn’t gone there. The distance is too much. His friendship with her brother could be on the line. What if they go there and it not only hurts them but Patrick as well. She told herself she wouldn’t do this but after one night with Patrick, she wants more but how could it possible work?

I love this couple!! Their relationship is easy but difficult at the same time. They just fit but live in different time zones. They click and feel comfortable with one another but have some difficulty communicating their feelings. That is what made it feel more real to me. The way they question themselves. I am not a let’s talk about our feelings type so I got it. Anyways...Patrick is a man’s man. A gentlemen with a roughness. A swoon-worthy bearded hottie who knows his way around a campfire and can make a mean s’mores after it’s built. Mia has a simple beauty on the outside and is a extraordinary beauty in the inside. Together they are fun, sexy, and have their obstacles to conquer. Oh!! I can not forget about Zeus, the most kickass cat ever. I would seriously read his story if Lauren ever went there.

Overall...it’s another Lauren book that you must read! I laughed, cried, felt the tingles. It also made me want to go for a hike and put a harness on my cat.

P.S. Their nicknames names for each other are the best. Unique and so them.

ARC provided by the author via Ink Slinger PR in exchange for an honest review.


I can’t believe this is the last book in the Big Rock world. It seems like yesterday that I fell in love with Lauren’s writing and her wonderful characters. Actually, Big Rock was my first book by hers and after that I could not stop reading: as soon as she drops a release, I am all over it! Well, of course, this one was no exception. And Lauren made it an epic ending!

Hard Wood is, as I said, part of Lauren Blakely’s Big Rock books but as all her other releases in this world this novel can be read as a standalone (though I highly recommend reading all the books because they are totally worth it!). This is the love story between Patrick and Mia: also known as Max’s friend (Joy Ride) and Max and Chase’s (Full Package) little sister. These two are very good friends but friends that are extremely attracted to each other. The problem is one of them leaves in San Francisco and one in New York. How can they act on their attraction if both fear this distance? Well.. nothing gets in the way of love!

When I see Mia, when I talk to Mia, when I spend time with Mia, it confirms my belief that some things are simple.

I FLOVE a good friends to lovers romance. It’s one of my favourite tropes in the genre and it’s always good that Lauren knows how to work with every single one of them! In Hard Wood I got everything I love in Blakely’s novels: a great plot, outstanding characters and lots of laughter, emotion and HEAT! Patrick and Mia have the most adorable friendship and they take it to the next level with their flirting and those moments with Patrick’s cat Zeus (OMG so cute and so funny!). It’s impossible not to love this couple!

I tried to put her in the friend zone. I tried hard, and I thought I’d succeeded. Maybe I was just fooling myself.
But there’s no fooling myself now.
Sometimes you don’t know where a trail goes, but you turn onto it anyway.

And of course, when these two actually accept the attraction cannot be stopped and they act on it.. HOLY CRAP! Absolute off-the-fucking-charts chemistry! Mia and Patrick are adorable as friends but as a couple they will melt your insides! Especially Patrick. I mean.. He is a normal man, a VERY SEXY normal guy and a man who is ready to settle down and he knows Mia is the one for him. I fucking adore him to pieces! And of course, Mia is sassy as heck and I loved it too! These two together are amazing in all the possible ways, if you know what I mean!

Something happens when you touch the person you’ve fantasized about for months. The person you’ve longed for. You not only want to fuck her, you want to adore her with every part of you.

So yeah, it will be hard to say goodbye to all these fantastic characters that Lauren gave us these last years and I will sure revisit them from time to time because I loved every single one of them. I loved having some moments will all of them in Hard Wood: it made it even more special for me. And boy.. does Lauren Blakely know how to give us a good ending: 3 epilogues, guys, 3 freaking epilogues! Hell yeah! I am definitely all over it! I loved this story so much!

Mia is the life I’ve imagined. She’s the dream I want to make real.

Therefore, my rating for Hard Wood is 5 STARS because Lauren just delivered another brilliant love story in the Big Rock world: surely one of my favourites! I loved Patrick and Mia, their cute moments together, that wonderful cat they have and their crazy chemistry. I loved all these characters so freaking much and loved reading all their love stories. It’s so sad to say goodbye to them but I know for sure that Lauren is creating more stories and characters that we will absolutely fall for too! Now, if you haven’t read this or any of the other books, I highly recommend you do. You will not regret it!

Who wouldn’t fall in love with an outdoorsman who loves animals? Certainly not me!! Patrick is such a great character! He’s normal, sweet, and downright swoony. Plus he wants to settle down. He’s a total winner, ladies!

Here’s the breakdown:
Patrick and Mia have been denying their mutual attraction for months. She’s his best friend’s little sister and she lives clear across the country. That doesn’t abate the attraction they both feel and the obvious connection they share. So, how can these make the best of a tough situation?

What I loved:
Epilogue Heaven and Conversations with Zeus were two of my highlights. I know that’s super vague. You’ll have to read to find out the real scoop. LOL
Shockingly, I enjoyed the slow burn. I enjoyed the natural progression of Mia and Patrick’s relationship. It’s cute and comfortable. After meeting them in previous books, it was nice to see their story unfold this way.
And last, but not least, the gangs all here! Lauren Blakely has a knack for tying her characters and universes together in a way that leaves the reader so satisfied. I loved catching up with previous couples from both series.

Overall, this is classic Lauren. Its LOL funny, sweet and swoony, with a bit of steam sprinkled in to keep things interesting. I really enjoyed it and highly recommend it to readers who love outdoor activities, super sweet male lead, and unbelievably cute kitties!
